about: Anam stock avatars (realistic) with Anam's American English voices, for the AI customer's face on a call. A customer's voice (female or male) picks the pool; the name picks the pair, so a customer always looks and sounds the same. An empty pool uses the other one. Find more ids with: python -m app.avatar list
